G-grouse-walk-0020.name: 2.0 km E of Goat Creek
G-grouse-walk-0020.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: Road: Caribou Mtn-Mainline FSR, 5.9 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
2 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.
Above 1,700 m: in Region 3 no motor vehicles except snowmobiles, except on existing roads and trails (synopsis page 33, 99%). Elevation from terrain tiles (estimate).

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-42 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Salmon Arm, about 124 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).

Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
